instruction: Look at seed_ss_gui_17_bridge_plate.dxf and continue editing that drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Use the existing end guides, tangent lines, and hole-location marks to create the final outer outline from two end circles of radius 18 connected by two parallel tangent lines. Overall length is 150 and overall height is 36. Add three diameter 6 holes on centerline y=18 with X coordinates 30, 75, and 120. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_17.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
